phenotype_specificity.statement: Infantile presentation with frontal-parietal and periventricular white matter change; family history recorded as normal. A 118-gene leukoencephalopathy panel was used, so other panel genes were sequenced; per-patient negative results for other genes are not stated.

de_novo.statement: Table 3 records the variant as de novo; methods state parents' blood was collected and Sanger validation was done in probands' parents. Per-family results and parentage confirmation are not reported.

concerns: Transcript: the paper gives NM_001131019.2 for this cDNA (not NM_002055.5), and its panel gene list gives NM_001242376 for GFAP; check that c.250 maps to the same base on NM_002055.5 (the hg19 coordinate chr17:42992605 T>A is stated).
Table-only description, no case narrative; de novo status comes from one table cell.
Read counts stated as 63 reference and 33 variant reads; the paper does not comment on allele fraction.
notes_for_panel: Infantile case from a Chinese panel study; de novo by table; three in-silico predictions reported.
